7. **P2 — Status ignores the declared timeout.**  
   [ex_mcp_client.ex:200](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/mcp/ex_mcp_client.ex:200)

   `status/2` discards its options. A test requested one millisecond and received success after 81 milliseconds. ExMCP’s status call uses its fixed GenServer timeout.

   **Correction:** Add timeout support to ExMCP’s public status API and pass the Connect timeout through it.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.

comments.text: Upstream API request: https://github.com/azmaveth/ex_mcp/issues/43 . Connect tracking: https://github.com/agentjido/jido_connect/issues/83 . Connect must pass the timeout after adopting the public API and verify generated action behavior.
